The loop moves verbatim into `AppendPrerequisites` at the same point in the outer loop body, so behaviour is unchanged, and it removes the nested `foreach` and two nested `if`s from `AppendMakeRecipes`, which should bring it from 16 to about 10 or below. I couldn't check the repo, so I'm assuming the new parameter types (`IReadOnlyDictionary`, `SortedSet<string>`) match what `AppendRule` accepts, which the diff doesn't show.
